name: Homm Bliss Southbeach Patong
short_description: A 71-room hotel on the quieter southern end of Patong's beach, with balconies or terraces facing the sea and a few minutes' walk from Walking Street.
ai_summary: Homm Bliss Southbeach Patong is a 71-room hotel positioned on the quieter southern end of Patong's 2.5-kilometre beach, overlooking white sands and sunset views while remaining just a few minutes' walk from Walking Street's nightlife. Every guest room or suite has its own balcony or terrace facing the beach and sea beyond. Guest reviews are consistently strong, praising the beachfront setting, cleanliness, and spacious sea-view rooms with clean pools and good breakfast, though a subset of reviews caution about noise from a nearby road and note the hotel's pricing runs higher than expected for the amenities delivered.

faqs.question: Is Homm Bliss Southbeach Patong directly on the beach?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it overlooks the quieter southern end of Patong's 2.5-kilometre beach, and every one of its 71 rooms and suites has its own balcony or terrace facing the sea, while still being a few minutes' walk from Walking Street's restaurants and nightlife.

faqs.question: Is Homm Bliss Southbeach Patong quieter than central Patong hotels?
faqs.answer: Yes -- its position on the southern end of the beach keeps it away from Patong's busiest strip, though a subset of reviews note some noise from a nearby road, so it's a middle ground between full seclusion and central Patong's nightlife energy.
